text:
Ellen: Quick note from QA on a foldable device: when the right sidebar slides in the runs table header duplicates (two thin headers) and the sticky filters get clipped by the safe-area notch. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/hinge-dup
Raj: Repro'd. Looks like we have two stacked sticky contexts: header is position:sticky inside main, and filters are another sticky inside subcontainer. On hinge/rotation visualViewport changes and our 100vh calc causes header overlap.
Marta: Minimal fix idea: stop using 100vh; set --vh from visualViewport and compute container heights from that. Also unify header+filters stickiness into a single sticky element to avoid double-stacks.
Marta: Example: ```js
const h = (window.visualViewport?.height || window.innerHeight);
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--vh', `${h}px`);
```
Ellen: Accessibility: touch targets for compact rows are tiny when condensed. Increase hit area to 44px min and ensure status pills have >=4.5:1 contrast. Also add aria-live polite announcing count changes when filters update.
a11y-bot: Recommend adding skip link anchor when sidebar opens so keyboard users can jump to the first row. Also ensure aria-hidden on inert background.
Raj: UX tradeoff: product wants to keep table at 380-420px but add a compact-card fallback below 380. For the condensed table add a sticky overflow indicator: subtle gradient on the right showing there's more content.
visual-bot: Added visual diff job "hinge-header-compact-cards" to canary. Will run on next push.
Marta: I'll open PR with --vh fix, combined sticky header, increased touch targets, and the copy tweak: empty state -> "No runs match your filters" + hint line. PR will include accessibility checklist and screenshots.
Ellen: P2 for sprint. Tagging design for a quick look tomorrow. :eyes:
